purpose: Agent assignment ledger for readiness before first governed CAPTURE_ONLY, exact market qualification and installed sender-free paper qualification.

gate_semantics.notes: Discovery-only CAPTURE_ONLY may run without a rooted RPC quorum if its manifest excludes rooted-state reads; any single-source observation must be labeled exploratory/BLOCKED_SINGLE_SOURCE. RPC-01 is mandatory before any rooted-state verdict or rooted multi-source capture.

tasks.summary: Implement executable CAMPAIGN_START_V1 CS-01..CS-10 before any transport or read; bind approval to exact manifest/profile/config/code/budget digests using canonical authorization owner.
actions: Finish the current #679 scope; reconcile against #671 templates.
Fail closed for absent/invalid operator proof, stale generations, unbound hashes, policy/source mismatch, budget overflow and non-sender-free RPC methods.
Add negative tests proving no transport/network open before gate PASS.
acceptance: Executable CLI/API gate called before transport construction/open.
Verified authorization and immutable digest binding; no invented boolean approval.
CS-01..CS-10 exact PASS receipt with blockers and zero network in negative tests.
must_not: Do not start CAPTURE_ONLY.
Do not enable paid sources or signer/sender/borrow/live.

tasks.owner: PR #679 CAM-03 + PR #671 source recheck artifacts
tasks.summary: Reconcile source IDs and aliases across discovery adapters, canonical catalog, provider profiles and campaign dossiers; refresh docs/terms/schema/quota with dated evidence.
actions: Read checked-in dossiers, then official docs for every source selected for capture.
Map discovery IDs dexscreener/geckoterminal/raydium/meteora to canonical provider/source IDs exactly; document aliases instead of renaming heuristically.
Record schema/auth/rate-limit/ToS/license/TTL and fail closed on stale/unknown terms.
acceptance: Every capture source has one canonical ID, owner, endpoint, current schema, auth mode, quota, terms/license and generation.
Source registry/dossier/profile crosswalk validates without ambiguous alias.
All unknowns remain disabled/BLOCKED.
must_not: Do not put secrets in code or PR.
Do not claim HTTP 200 or documentation alone as live verification.

tasks.summary: Prove and complete the bounded intake→durable raw evidence path for all selected data sources using existing canonical storage.
actions: Trace SourceIntakePlane.collect, adapters, CampaignEvidenceStore and AGG-02 to determine exact ownership; don't create another journal.
Preserve raw body or immutable content reference, request fingerprint, response hash, source ID/generation, endpoint, UTC, cursor/gap, attempt count, status, latency and typed rejects.
Make retries/idempotence/save failures observable; ensure quotas account for physical attempts and process restart.
Add zero-network deterministic replay and corruption/partial-write tests.
acceptance: Every accepted/rejected attempt has durable trace and raw evidence reference/hash.
Replay recomputes from retained bytes with zero outbound network and deterministic digest.
No silently discarded save errors, unbounded retries or in-memory-only global limits.
must_not: No outbound live source request before campaign authorization.
No second raw store or transport.

tasks.summary: Validate two genuinely independent rooted RPC profiles for any rooted market-state verdict.
actions: Verify source/operator/correlation-group independence rather than endpoint or API-key count.
Bind same genesis, finalized/rooted commitment, per-response context slots, minContextSlot, bounded observed skew and account-state hashes.
Keep each batch context separate; reject mixed/stale state and single-source rooted claims.
Reconcile actual safe RPC methods with runtime and connections-registry allowlists.
acceptance: Positive test with independent sources and coherent rooted state; negative tests for same operator, same correlation group, genesis/slot/hash disagreement, stale source and public smoke endpoint.
BLOCKED_SINGLE_SOURCE is explicit; no shared/public RPC can satisfy rooted quorum by default.
must_not: Do not open RPC requests until operator-authorized manifest and profiles are approved.
Do not add getBlock/other methods without call-site proof.

tasks.summary: Make canonical mint identity safe for campaign admission and exact quote eligibility.
actions: Require live owner/program/decimals evidence before HARD_BOUND; registry/reference decimals are hints only.
Parse Token-2022 extensions and fail closed on unknown extension/transfer hook/unsupported fee semantics.
Bind chain genesis, mint, token program, decimals, extensions, pool token ordering and canonical alias relationships.
Test ticker collision, wrong mint/program/decimals, missing live proof and unsupported extension.
acceptance: Every HARD_BOUND asset has evidence refs, current source generation, exact decimals/program/extensions.
Unknown or inconsistent identity returns typed blocker; no ticker inference.
must_not: Do not alter broad research-universe preservation.
Do not mark missing decimals as verified.

tasks.summary: Establish bounded source rotation, discovery completeness and truthful capability classes.
actions: Implement only existing adapters/endpoints with current source dossiers, quotas, page/timeout bounds and negative-control fraction from manifest.
Classify each source STREAMING/POLL_ONLY/ONE_SHOT/UNAVAILABLE based on actual running producer, cadence, cursor/gap/reconnect proof.
Use SOL/USDC only as search hint; preserve broad candidate universe and all typed rejects.
Keep discovery/indexer, aggregator comparator, reference/oracle and rooted RPC roles distinct.
acceptance: Per-source request/attempt/candidate counts, response size, latency, quota status, schema drift and rejects are receipted.
No unsupported claim of streaming; deterministic replay; stage denominators reported.
No duplicate catalog or discovery adapter.
must_not: No paid provider activation or credential probing.
No aggregator route counted as independent liquidity.

tasks.summary: Make native Windows 11 verification real and reproducible.
actions: Regenerate lock via pinned uv to restore platform markers; never hand-edit generated lock.
Fix SQLite handle/journal lifecycle and explicit close/context manager for WinError 32.
Fix pytest-socket interaction with ProactorEventLoop narrowly while keeping external DNS/TCP/UDP blocked.
Capture actual Windows Caption/DisplayVersion/build/architecture and Python x64; run verify_repo/package smoke and focused/full tests.
acceptance: Windows package wheelhouse/lock smoke PASS.
Temporary DB cleanup works without ignore_errors.
Event-loop tests pass with outbound internet still blocked.
Native Windows receipt includes exact commands/counts; Windows is primary target.
must_not: Do not use Linux/WSL as substitute for native Windows.
Do not turn socket blocking off globally.

tasks.summary: Reproduce and classify genuine full-suite failures after Windows Proactor setup is repaired.
actions: Re-run the historical baseline clusters on clean latest main and clean native Windows checkout.
Investigate unresolved synthetic path ValueError in GPR03; preserve minimal reproducer and regression test.
Separate actual code defects from CRLF/hash checkout, missing dependencies, Unix-only tests and environment-only failures.
Create separate focused implementation PRs for distinct canonical owners.
acceptance: Every baseline test ID has reproduced status, owner, root cause and disposition.
Genuine defect has minimal regression test and isolated fix PR.
No failure waived as pre-existing without same-SHA reproduction.
must_not: Do not fold unrelated GPR/TON/MPR fixes into #679 unless same owner and user-approved.

tasks.summary: Repair exact GitHub verifier failures already observed on #665 branch.
actions: Fix vendor_mirror_sha256sums mismatches by proving line-ending/byte source and exact mirror regeneration; do not guess.
Fix results_digest_chain mismatch between caller_profile_results.csv and scenario manifest/receipt.
Re-run all GitHub verifier checks on exact PR head; keep all work in #665 branch.
Audit evidence volume/retention policy separately; preserve all scenario evidence and no destructive cleanup.
acceptance: GitHub verifier reaches all required checks PASS on exact head, not only local claim.
Manifest, result CSV and evidence digests chain consistently.
Provenance, licenses and source pins remain intact.
must_not: Do not edit #665 files from this assignment PR branch.
Do not delete/collapse evidence to make tests pass.

tasks.summary: Use the three audit outputs to implement the first SHA-bound deterministic code graph/catalogue/query/context-pack slice defined by #666.
actions: Build from latest SHA; one canonical snapshot/index owner; parser/resolver pinned; all files coverage-statused.
Implement task_context and expand_context with adaptive dimensions, stale-SHA refusal, exact refs, omission continuation and hard tokenizer budgets.
Use #681 42-question golden corpus; improve required-ref recall target in #666 at ≤2000 tokens and record false edges, freshness and latency.
Require clean-vs-incremental parity, rename/delete handling, stale-SHA rejection, secret filtering and deterministic graph checksum.
Provide one stable read-only MCP facade only if its connected local service exists; CLI and MCP share one backend.
acceptance: W0B implementation tests and benchmark receipt meet #666 contract on exact SHA.
No graph claim based solely on static inventory; no second graph/store.
Task context contains exact function/test/config/provider refs and zero hidden truncation.
must_not: Not a blocker for CAPTURE_ONLY if its evidence owners are sound.
Do not start broad A-H infra sweep; #666 explicitly defers it.

tasks.summary: Turn already offline-tested venue quote engines into current-state exact market evidence without replacing existing owners.
actions: Reconcile #660 report and #660 merge head with latest main; pin current official program/SDK state and deployed program IDs.
Complete full direct-account state closure per venue; prove batch context/slot consistency and account hashes.
Differential-check amount-specific quote output against official pinned SDK/program fixtures and, only under separate authorization, rooted live snapshots.
For every input amount, record complete fees, consumed input, tick/bin traversal, token extensions, timestamp/epoch, state hash/generation and expiry.
Preserve typed fail-closed handling for missing arrays, dynamic fee, partial fill, transfer hook, unknown extension and stale state.
acceptance: Independent positive/negative fixtures and deterministic offline replay.
Live evidence clearly separated from fixture/replay and linked to actual rooted account hashes when authorized.
No quote admitted if any dependent account or freshness condition is missing.
must_not: Do not make live reads by default.
Do not duplicate #659/#660 quote/route owners.

tasks.owner: Existing strategy registry / R10 / #659 and #660 lineage
tasks.summary: Select a narrow first-wave strategy set by proven same-chain exact data requirements; preserve the full research universe.
actions: Refresh the crosswalk against latest main and all open PRs.
For each first-wave strategy define required mints, venue/account state, fee model, exact quote grid, source freshness, capital requirements and failure reasons.
Keep signal-only, conditional, hedged-non-atomic and research-only paths outside local atomic execution.
Separate N02 event-to-state, N03 stablecoin anchors, N04 Pump migration, LST spot identity and CLOB/liquidation work into individual PRs when justified.
acceptance: Every enabled paper candidate is backed by explicit StrategyDataRequirement and source/venue owner; unsupported families remain typed blocked.
No false promise of full strategy-family coverage from one route.
must_not: Do not shrink broad discovery universe to flash-borrowable tokens.
Do not combine async cross-chain routes into atomic route math.

tasks.owner: PR #677 Jupiter Lend N06; matching R03-A
tasks.summary: Complete Jupiter Lend resource-level capacity proof and its matching unsigned builder where supported.
actions: Complete offline exact source/IDL pin checks and tests in #677.
After separately authorized rooted reads, verify reserve/vault/debt ceiling/liabilities/utilization/availability/fee and decimals at accepted slots.
Prove builder instruction semantics and borrow/repay coverage; do not infer fee=0 from docs.
acceptance: R02-CAP-A yields admitted resource/asset/amount evidence with source slots and fee math; matching R03-A conforms and has negative tests.
Offline-only result stays UNQUALIFIED for paper.
must_not: No account creation/borrowing.

tasks.summary: Finish Project 0 deployed state rebind and same-resource unsigned builder proof.
actions: Verify deployed program/bank/IDL/SDK pins and source hashes.
Rooted read only after operator authorization: asset, cap, fee, callback, account eligibility and fresh resource state.
Prove exact start/end bookends and typed block for unsupported/unknown end semantics.
acceptance: R02-CAP-D and R03-D share exact deployment/resource identity, mint/principal and callback semantics.
No offline-only capacity promoted to live.
must_not: No wallet/account/ATA/position creation or borrow.

tasks.owner: PR #669 Kamino N08; R03-B owner remains separately governed
tasks.summary: Finish Kamino deployed-state/SDK proof, distinguishing a flash borrow from ordinary obligation borrowing.
actions: Complete SDK/type pins and decode verification.
Only test the supported flashloan instruction; do not mistake standard borrow for flash borrowing.
Rooted capacity evidence and eligibility only under campaign authorization.
Coordinate the matching R03-B owner and prevent shared path edits.
acceptance: R02-CAP-B plus matching R03-B meet the same resource, mint, fee and repay semantics.
Unknown deployed state remains BLOCKED.
must_not: No obligation creation or borrow.

tasks.owner: N10 Save/Solend proof; MarginFi stays PR #655/R10-2 separate; Sui NAVI later
tasks.summary: Keep alternate capital providers as research-only until actual flash support, resource, deployed state and same-transaction repayment are proven.
actions: One proof dossier per provider; current API/deployment/fee/cap/repay semantics and license.
Do not pool wrappers or aggregators as independent lenders.
Do not merge Sui capital into Solana first-wave qualification.
acceptance: Provider-specific dossier establishes support or leaves RESEARCH_CANDIDATE with exact missing proof.
No implementation until proof exists.
must_not: No speculative adapter or shared capacity inference.

tasks.owner: Existing R04 candidate selector owner from current TASK_INDEX / owner map
tasks.summary: Complete R04 over a proven subset using the existing selector and canonical owners.
actions: Coordinator freezes API after current owner inspection.
Require exact route legs, verified identity, complete quote, same-state fingerprints, unique physical liquidity, one admitted resource and matching builder.
Calculate amount-specific net result including every fee/cost/repayment leg; reject partial fills/unknowns.
acceptance: Positive/negative R04 tests; trace every input candidate and typed rejection; no manual bypass flag.
Candidate includes exact selected lender resource and builder identity.
must_not: Do not build a second selector/solver.

paths: existing R05 final message/PTB simulation owner
tasks.summary: Simulate the exact complete final transaction/message/PTB and reconcile full economics and repayment.
actions: Use exact final serialized message and exact account metas, borrow/route/repay order, compute-budget and all fee/tip/rent data.
Bind simulation to same code/source/state generations, blockhash/slot and amount selected by R04.
Prove balance deltas and repayment; no log-text heuristic or leg-only simulations.
Negative test missing/changed instruction, stale blockhash, insufficient repayment, Token-2022 fee, partial fill, unknown cost and state drift.
acceptance: R05 PASS is bound to exact final message/PTB digest and same state evidence; economic reconciliation has no UNKNOWN fields.
No simulation result can be substituted from another amount/route/resource.
must_not: No signing or submission.

tasks.owner: OCA-W10 / EventEnvelope + ObservabilityStore + AGG-02 + MarketEpisode owners
tasks.summary: Wire real, idempotent production events across supported sender-free market and paper stages.
actions: Re-run #680 make_event and ObservabilityStore callsite audit on latest main.
Add only missing producers for discovery, observation, quote, opportunity, route, capital, build, sim, terminal/reject, retries/reconnect/cancel/restart.
Set actual runtime_id, producer_code_version, environment, trace/aggregate/attempt generation; no test defaults in production.
Keep event evidence links to raw AGG-02/market/paper owners without duplicating canonical payload.
Map strategy/provider/venue routes WIRED/PARTIAL/NO_RUNTIME_PATH/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN.
acceptance: Producer→store→export→replay test covers each supported stage; duplicate/retry idempotence and missing-event negative tests.
No silent producer loss; all events correlate to exact market/source/state and attempt identity.
No separate event bus or duplicate canonical store.
must_not: Do not deploy NATS/Debezium/Marquez/DataHub as a shortcut.

tasks.owner: Canonical installed paper service + src/paper_shadow composition + QPR/R06
tasks.summary: Qualify and run the existing installed sender-free paper vertical only after exact R06/QPR/campaign PASS.
actions: Verify installed artifact/wheel and supported composition root; all mandatory exact dependencies supplied with valid identities/hashes.
Use canonical durable journal/lifecycle/outcomes; no custom runner, no synthetic success, no fixture counts mixed with live.
All admitted attempts reach durable terminal result with exact rejection/no-trade reasons.
Produce deterministic zero-network replay and separate live/replay populations.
acceptance: QPR-01/02/03 + campaign authority return exact PASS on same pinned config/source generation.
R06 receipt reports 0 UNKNOWN terminal, durable events, exact simulation linkage, restart recovery and replay equality.
Paper mode remains sender-free and live/sign/send disabled.
must_not: Do not start 24h/72h paper qualification on non-PASS gate.
Do not claim profitability from a short/noisy observation window.

tasks.owner: MPR-05 installed paper qualification + existing lifecycle/observability owners
tasks.summary: Run installed soak and failure-injection qualification with durable operational SLOs.
actions: Test provider outage/quota exhaustion, RPC quorum loss, stale state, schema drift, clock/slot skew, DB contention/corruption, restart, cancellation, backpressure, disk cap and shutdown drain.
Measure event loop lag, queue age, heartbeat, terminal SLO, recovery and replay divergence.
Run MPR-05 72h installed soak if required by the release path; use installed wheel/container and exact dependency hashes.
acceptance: Every fault has deterministic expected terminal state and recovery receipt.
No stuck UNKNOWN terminal, data loss or hidden outbound replay request.
72-hour soak reported separately from data-capture observation.
must_not: No live transaction delivery.

tasks.summary: Maintain one evidence-backed status ledger and produce an explicit go/no-go decision per stage.
actions: Update each row only from PR/test/CI/campaign receipts, not agent claims.
Report numerator/denominator, source class, exact SHA, PR, blocker and owner.
Publish separate verdicts: CAPTURE_ONLY_READY, EXACT_MARKET_READY, PAPER_QUALIFIED, LIVE_HARD_DENIED.
Keep live authorization as separate future process.
acceptance: Machine-readable status + concise runbook/report are replayable and reflect actual evidence.
Every P0 task is PASS or has an explicit typed blocker; no implicit ready state.
must_not: Do not promote stage by merging docs.
